steps.path: Click the tag element in the bottom status bar
steps.headline: Tags & note is now Session details, as you approved it: name, note, one Tags card, Pin to top.
steps.changed: The name leads the top card (click to rename); the note shows in quotes and italics, or "+ Add a note". This session's tags come first, larger; the others below "Add a tag". Pictures at your 1.5× scale. "Before" is the main redesign branch, so this shows every tags change since then.
steps.notice: Everything about the session in one popup; nothing needs saving.
steps.risk: A long note makes the top card tall and pushes the tags down.

steps.path: Resume → the tag icon on a conversation
steps.headline: Resume's organize sheet is the same page, minus the name — the card right above already shows it.
steps.changed: The Note box became the note card ("+ Add a note" or the quoted note); tags and Pin to top as in the popup. The side panel and Projects preview get the same.
steps.notice: Organizing a conversation looks the same wherever you do it.
steps.risk: Without a name above it, the note card can look a little empty until a note is written.

steps.path: Click the session name at the top of the window
steps.headline: Tag pills everywhere: the original icon, word and icon drawn as one line so they stay level.
steps.changed: The fix from the live comparison ("As now"), in every tag pill in the app.
steps.notice: Tags line up with their icons on your screen.

steps.path: Close a session (the × on its tab)
steps.headline: The close prompt keeps its editor for now — only its tag pills changed, as you asked.
steps.changed: Its summary shows the new pills; its editor waits for the follow-up you asked for.

steps.path: The bottom strip of the window
steps.headline: The status bar element as you approved it earlier: pin, stacked tag colours, note page.
steps.changed: Approved in the tags deck ("Priority +1" became icons); shown again because "Before" here is the main redesign branch, which doesn't have it yet.
steps.notice: Pinned, tagged and noted are told apart at a glance.
